feature.formula: highlight_decoded_index = target_timeline_index + integer_offset; target_timeline_index derives from source_pts
feature.score_formula: mean((target_feature - highlight_feature)^2) over concatenated standardized grayscale/Sobel-x/Sobel-y elements

derived_offset_bounds.full_row_validity: every one of 191 target rows maps to an in-range decoded highlight index

global_search.formula: highlight_decoded_index = target_timeline_index + integer_offset; target_timeline_index derives from source_pts
global_search.margin_formula: runner_up_mean_score - best_mean_score; positive means best is lower/error-better

monotone_refinement.repeat_semantics: nondecreasing highlight decoded index; repeated decoded frames allowed and counted as repeated observations

decode.method: OpenCV VideoCapture sequential read, retaining every decoded RGB frame in memory

target_manifest.source_pts_gap_validation: all (source_pts-base_pts)%1001==0; one 2002-tick gap 478->479 represents an omitted nominal timeline ordinal

limitations: Higher resolution cannot resolve Mario clones, red fragments, or HUD-like red components without temporal certainty; ambiguous/failed localizer rows remain null.
Alignment is between two lossy YouTube-derived encodes, not original source frames.
The target encoded index and highlight decoded index are media indices; source PTS is a separate 1/30000-clock field.
No N64 VI cadence, game state, mechanism, emulator scenario, or RAM inference follows from this image audit.
The overlay PNG directory is corroboration only and is not consumed by this report.

scaled_fields.candidate_score_scale: multiplied by area_scale because blue-pixel and area score terms scale with pixel area
scaled_fields.max_score: multiplied by area_scale because candidate scores are area-scaled
scaled_fields.neighborhood_radii: each source radius converted to independent integer x/y radii
scaled_fields.overlay_region: x coordinates multiplied by x_scale; y coordinates multiplied by y_scale
scaled_fields.pixel_distance_gate: multiplied by arithmetic mean of x_scale and y_scale as fixed Euclidean-pixel approximation
scaled_fields.roi: x coordinates multiplied by x_scale; y coordinates multiplied by y_scale

provenance.configuration_changes: only deterministic 340x215-to-720x480 geometry/area scaling; HSV thresholds, masks, Viterbi costs, null semantics retained
provenance.method: adapted fixed red/blue component candidates and forward/back Viterbi from fit_vod_render_motion.py

localizer.sequence_method: unique aligned decoded indices tracked in forward and reversed order; selected only when both paths are non-null and within fixed tolerance; all other rows null

probe.timestamp_verification: OpenCV sequential decoder index joined to ffprobe best_effort_timestamp

status_reason: fixed evidence-quality material-improvement criterion evaluated against reliable non-null rows
